required_audit_coverage.name: required_audit_coverage
required_audit_coverage.detail: report covers all 44 Required Audit items with substantive aligned answers
required_audit_items: Is execution still on `agent/terminal-status-propagation-seal-restart-rework-v3` and Draft PR #5 targeting `main`?
Is v10 `APPROVED`, `engineering_branch`, and bound to active `reverse-agent-iteration@v2`?
Is the committed v10 Decision the sole current authority, with `task_packet.json` background-only?
Is the v10 Decision commit an ancestor of every v10 implementation, evidence, and final publication commit?
Are v4-v9 archived or previously published artifacts unchanged?
Does the report record that v9 ended `BLOCKED` without substantive changes, commits, or pushes?
Was v10 Decision content locked before the bootstrap mutation window opened?
Were pre-bootstrap hashes or exact contents captured for both workflow files?
During the bootstrap window, were only the two authorized workflow files modified?
In each workflow, was only the existing `Project gate preflight` command changed?
Was the only textual change the addition of `--allow-consumed`?
Were no source, test, state, report, context, manifest, archive, or other workflow files modified before final plan lock?
Were the bootstrap edits uncommitted and unpushed until the final command-plan was verified and locked?
Was canonical command-plan generation the only executable pre-plan exception used?
Did the generated command-plan include the exact updated State Gate command with workflow path and CI-only execution surface?
Did it include the exact updated Decision Preflight command with workflow path and CI-only execution surface?
For both commands, is local transcript not required and exact remote execution evidence required?
Was the canonical command-plan digest locked before source, test, state, report, context, manifest, archive, or additional workflow work?
Does a new v10 execution segment exist with v10 IDs, Decision digest, plan digest, startup time, and unique restart identity?
Does local strict preflight without `--allow-consumed` still block a current Decision consumed by a successful current-round report?
Does workflow validation with `--allow-consumed` pass only for a valid consumed current Decision?
Does wrong Decision ID still fail under `--allow-consumed`?
Does wrong round ID still fail under `--allow-consumed`?
Does a failed or non-success report still fail under `--allow-consumed`?
Does a non-APPROVED Decision or inactive skill still fail?
Do wrong branch, missing Decision ancestry, forbidden path, stale evidence, and command-plan mismatch still fail?
Is `.github/workflows/ci.yml` unchanged?
Does `local-ci-parity` pass for all three workflows with zero required gaps?
Are CI-only commands absent from the local transcript while still represented by exact workflow authority?
Did focused tests cover bootstrap order, strict-versus-consumed preflight, wrong identities, failed reports, workflow parity, and immutable-head evidence?
Does `pytest_result.txt` contain real commands, outputs, exit codes, and passing totals consistent with the report?
Do report-summary and execution-log pass with v10 IDs and truthful chronology?
Does final-check pass?
Does run-closeout pass and close-round produce `CLOSED`?
Are context, state manifest, round manifest, archived report, archived pytest, and final seal current and mutually consistent?
Are all changed files inside the v10 allowlist?
Were merge, rebase, force-push, direct-main push, branch creation, new PR creation, and `git add -A` avoided?
Is PR #6 still untouched and `QUEUED_NOT_ACTIVE`?
Is the final v10 validation commit the exact PR #5 head with no later branch commit?
Did CI complete successfully for the exact final v10 head?
Did State Gate complete successfully for the exact final v10 head?
Did Decision Preflight complete successfully for the exact final v10 head?
Were exact-head remote results observed externally without a post-attestation commit?
Do the exact-head results support one of the four allowed final audit conclusions?
